notes:
POC focused on PR assistant for GitHub-flow repos; main goals: automated diff summaries, high-quality comment suggestions, prioritization/rerank of review comments. Wants streaming low-latency for IDE copilots when devs request inline suggestions (goal <50ms token start for completion), and robust model/version pinning for reproducible code generation across releases.

Key quotes: "We cannot risk leaking internal code — need strict VPC/on-prem option + KMS"; "If you can prove stable latency at scale, we can convert to dedicated pool".

Highlights from recent calls: quick demo 2026-02-14 (ff link above) — internal devs impressed by diff-summarization clarity; security team sent questionnaire 2026-02-21; legal returned initial redlines 2026-03-02. POC repo: github.com/compileguard/core (sample dataset, ~120k LOC across 90 repos).

Acceptance criteria for POC: 1) avg diff-summary F1 > 0.7 on benchmark set, 2) comment generation precision > 65% (manual eval), 3) streaming latency under 60ms p50 at 256-token bursts, 4) successful SSO + audit log ingestion into their SIEM.

Decisions: lean toward Dedicated for predictable throughput but require Private/on-prem option for enterprise customers. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for quantization/profile to lower token costs for nightly batch reranking jobs.
